en: Deployed right at highway toll-station edges, using multimodal interaction to handle lane exceptions, fare inquiries, and anomaly checks—bringing digital toll operators into live frontline traffic service.

zh: 在内网离线环境下梳理与核验企业信息资产，自动比对权属台账、合规条款与风险缺口，沉淀结构化的审计底稿。
en: Inventories and verifies enterprise information assets offline within your intranet, cross-checking ownership ledgers, compliance clauses, and risk gaps to produce structured audit workpapers.

zh: 基层事务 AI 助理
贴合社区与基层一线的高频事务，辅助完成群众诉求归类、政策条文检索与台账文书整理，把工作人员从繁杂填报中解放出来。
en: Built for high-frequency community and frontline public-service workflows—classifying resident requests, retrieving policy clauses, and organizing ledgers to free staff from repetitive paperwork.

zh: 结合设备能耗数据与峰谷运行规律，实时研判用能异常并推演最优排程，辅助企业在不影响产出的前提下持续降本增效。
en: Combines equipment energy telemetry with peak–off-peak load patterns to flag usage anomalies in real time and model optimal schedules—cutting energy costs without compromising output.

zh: AI 文档识别与翻译知识库
en: AI Document Recognition, Translation and Knowledge Base

zh: 将高精度版面 OCR、多语种专业翻译与本地知识库融为一体，让扫描件与外文资料一键转化为可精准溯源的企业知识资产。
en: Unites high-accuracy layout OCR, specialist multilingual translation, and a local knowledge base—turning scans and foreign-language files into traceable enterprise knowledge in one step.

zh: AI 录音卡片会议总结
支持将多品类数十张 AI 录音卡片集中接入 RM-01，数据不出本地即可完成语音自动转写、发言归类与纪要提炼，形成开箱即用的软硬件一体方案。
en: Connect dozens of AI recording cards across categories directly to RM-01 for on-premise transcription, speaker attribution, and meeting summaries—an out-of-the-box hardware-and-software solution that keeps every recording local.

zh: 以本地 OCR 识别与语义索引盘活海量纸质及电子档案，实现自动归类、关键要素抽取与秒级检索，让沉睡卷宗真正为业务所用。
en: Brings vast paper and digital archives back to life with local OCR and semantic indexing—automating classification, key-field extraction, and sub-second search so dormant records actively serve daily operations.

在无人机自动巡航现场本地解析航拍影像，精准甄别林区火情误报、及时定位户外活动人员，缩短应急研判的响应链路。
en: Analyzes aerial footage locally at autonomous drone docks—filtering out false forest-fire alerts and locating people in outdoor areas to shorten emergency response times.

en: Reaches deep into automotive R&D and shop-floor workflows—covering 2D part drawings to 3D modeling, assembly simulation, offline industrial welding-robot programming, and safety inspection to accelerate engineering iteration.

en: Operates fully offline on confidential case dossiers, helping defence counsel map event timelines, cross-check witness transcripts, and surface contradictions across evidence chains to build stronger leads.

zh: AI 汽车功能安全检测
紧扣车规级功能安全标准，在本地辅助完成安全需求核查、失效模式推演与测试报告审查，为研发合规提供严密把关。
en: Aligned with automotive functional-safety standards, assisting teams locally with safety-requirement verification, failure-mode analysis, and test-report audits to uphold strict R&D compliance.

zh: 高速公路现场智能协同
扎根收费站、隧道、桥梁与路域光伏站点，打通本地多源感知、异常智能研判与应急联动处置，守护高速路网全天候平稳运行。
en: Deployed across toll stations, tunnels, bridges, and roadside solar sites—linking local multi-source sensing, intelligent anomaly assessment, and coordinated emergency response to keep highway networks running smoothly around the clock.

zh: 引脚、服务与系统行为皆可由 JSON 声明定义。现场部署不必反复改代码，每一项设备配置也清晰可溯。
en: Pins, services, and system behavior are all defined declaratively in JSON. On-site deployment requires fewer code changes, and every device configuration stays clear and traceable.

zh: 北向调度推理算力，南向统筹通用计算与存储。TianshanOS 贯通两端，让机内每个模组各安其位、各尽其责。
en: Northbound control orchestrates inference compute; southbound control manages general-purpose compute and storage. TianshanOS bridges both sides so every internal module stays in its lane and performs at its best.

zh: 模型、密钥与现场参数的下发，容不得模糊边界。配置包内置 ECDH、AES-256-GCM 加密与 ECDSA 签名校验，为每一次交付筑牢安全防线。
en: Delivering models, keys, and site parameters leaves no room for ambiguity. Config packs combine ECDH, AES-256-GCM encryption, and ECDSA signature verification to establish a clear security boundary for every deployment.

zh: 支持 HTTPS 与 SD 卡双通道升级，异常时自动回滚。WebUI、CLI 与 API 多入口齐备，规则引擎接管重复事务，把日常运维从繁琐的手动操作中解放出来。
en: Update over HTTPS or SD card with automatic rollback if anything goes wrong. Manage the device via WebUI, CLI, or API while the rule engine takes over routine tasks—freeing daily operations from manual busywork.

zh: x86 / 8 核 8 线程 / 16GB–32GB ECC / 512GB–2TB NVMe
内置独立 x86 计算单元，为 Agent 与业务应用提供专属运行环境。工具调用、代码执行与数据库读写尽在应用侧完成，不抢占推理算力；完整兼容主流 x86 软件生态，现有业务系统与工具链可顺滑接入 Agent 工作流。
en: An independent x86 computer gives agents and business applications their own dedicated runtime. Tool calls, code execution, and database access happen on the application side without competing for inference compute. Broad x86 software compatibility lets existing tools and business systems plug smoothly into agent workflows.

zh: 自研推理引擎配合高速内部互联，将全部算力与显存聚焦于模型推理及 KV Cache，为更大参数规模、更长上下文与更高并发留足余量。
en: Our inference engine and high-speed internal interconnect focus every drop of compute and VRAM on model inference and KV Cache—leaving generous headroom for larger models, longer contexts, and higher concurrency.

zh: 后训练模型、RAG 知识库、业务数据与应用代码，都是你的核心资产。独立安全模组在硬件层隔离私钥，严防导出与非法复制，为每一份数字资产划出设备级安全边界。
en: Your post-trained models, RAG knowledge bases, business data, and application code are core assets. An independent security module isolates private keys in hardware, guarding against export and duplication to draw a device-level security boundary around every asset.

zh: 内部交换 / 路由 / 统一 API
调用本地 AI，照样享受云服务般顺手的接口体验。板载交换、路由与统一 API 串联全机模组，无论是横向扩展还是日常维护，都无需大动干戈。
en: Call local AI with the same effortless API experience you expect from the cloud. Onboard switching, routing, and unified APIs link every module so scaling out and routine maintenance stay simple.

en: USB-C PD 3.1 / up to 140W / independent Z-shaped air duct

zh: 统一供电、精准上电时序与 Z 型独立风道协同护航，从容抵御频繁启停、持续高负载与粉尘侵扰——少停机、少维护，工作自然少被打扰。
en: Unified power delivery, precise startup sequencing, and an independent Z-shaped air duct safeguard operation against frequent power cycles, sustained heavy loads, and dust—meaning less downtime, less maintenance, and fewer interruptions to your work.

zh: 沿用熟悉生态，省去重复适配
定制 vLLM 延续 Hugging Face 生态，以自研内核提速推理；C++ 及 Rust 专用引擎则紧贴模型架构与硬件特性，重构权重加载、算子与运行时。两条路线均支持 RMQ 模型，并兼容 OpenAI 及 Anthropic Messages 等主流接口，省去繁琐的迁移与适配。
en: Custom vLLM preserves the Hugging Face ecosystem and accelerates inference with our own kernels, while our dedicated C++ and Rust engines tailor weight loading, operators, and runtime directly to model architectures and hardware. Both paths support RMQ models and expose OpenAI- and Anthropic Messages–compatible APIs, eliminating tedious migration and integration work.

zh: 更长上下文，更高并发度
分页 KV Cache 与递归状态管理共同承接长文记忆，前缀缓存复用已有计算；专用引擎更以内存与 SSD 分层存储拓宽上下文边界。配合批量输入与连续批处理，大幅减少权重重复读取，让长文档分析、多轮交互与并发请求从容共享算力。
en: Paged KV Cache and recurrent-state management preserve long-context memory, while prefix caching reuses prior computation. Our dedicated engines extend context capacity further through memory–SSD tiering. Paired with batched input processing and continuous batching, they cut repeated weight reads so document analysis, multi-turn dialogue, and concurrent requests share compute effortlessly.

zh: 从推理出发，倒推整机设计
主板与推理引擎从底层协同设计，围绕 GPU 算力、内存带宽与缓存结构重排计算与访存路径。投影合并、算子融合与专家归组削减数据搬运开销；MTP 与批量解码各司其职，兼顾单路极速生成与多路并发吞吐，把硬件规格真正转化为推理效率。
en: The motherboard and inference engine are co-designed from the ground up, aligning computation and data access with GPU compute, memory bandwidth, and cache hierarchy. Merged projections, operator fusion, and expert grouping cut data movement; MTP and batched decoding work in tandem for fast single-stream generation and high-concurrency throughput—turning hardware specs into real inference speed.

en: Precision hardware calls for unified command. TianshanOS coordinates every module and system behavior inside RM-01, keeping inference, applications, and storage working in concert. Bring RM-01 straight to your business site—no dedicated power, rewiring, or server room required.

en: One cable for power. One cable for the network. Smart glasses, laptops, routers, phones, and tablets all become gateways to local AI—connecting the devices you already use to dedicated compute right beside you.

en: Applications get their own runtime space; inference gets dedicated compute. RM-01 brings models, applications, and runtime into a single chassis, turning tight module collaboration directly into business productivity.

en: Inside the compact chassis, inference, applications, interconnect, and cooling each hold their own place. As the structure unfolds, the pathways between modules emerge—revealing the architecture of a complete local AI system at a glance.

自研推理引擎深挖算力与显存效率，大幅压低运行开销——为更大模型、更长上下文与更高并发，腾出真正可用的空间。
en: Our inference engine pushes compute and GPU memory efficiency further while cutting runtime overhead—opening real headroom for larger models, longer contexts, and higher concurrency.

en: EricLake pairs ultra-thin custom blades, a bespoke motor, and an independent Z-shaped air duct to exhaust heat under high-concurrency loads. Refined through rounds of CFD simulation, its closed structure seals dust away from core components—built for full-load sprints and quiet, day-after-day operation alike.

en: Light sweeps across the facets, tracing the sapphire’s crisp outline against the silver-white chassis. Exterior bonding joins the gemstone seamlessly to the surface while preserving every sharp, sculpted edge. Sapphire’s extreme hardness makes shaping and mirror polishing a test at every step—56 hours of carving and polishing distilled into this single moment of cool, crystalline brilliance.

en: Ultra-high-speed injection-molded blades built for sustained, round-the-clock cooling.

zh: 推理不止，散热亦不停歇。TTI 经由 TTO 实时感知热状态，以神经网络预判未来 90 秒的功率走势，提前推演 15、45、90 秒后的温升曲线。它不只盯着眼前的温度，更记得热量如何一步步积蓄——热未起，风量已先就位；热渐平，转速悄然回落。少一分骤起骤落的躁动，无论环境与负载如何流转，始终从容以对。
en: Inference never pauses, and neither does cooling. Through TTO, TTI reads the thermal state in real time, while a neural network forecasts power shifts over the next 90 seconds and projects temperatures at 15, 45, and 90 seconds. It looks beyond the temperature of the moment—remembering how heat has been building. Before temperatures climb, airflow is already in place; as heat settles, fan speed eases back quietly. Fewer abrupt swings, effortless composure across any environment or workload.

zh: 模型源自真实设备的海量运行数据。面对难以预知的突发负载，基础温控曲线、配置上限与独立保护机制始终在底层稳稳托底。
en: Trained on real operating data from live devices. For sudden, unpredictable workloads, the base thermal curve, configured limits, and independent protection policies always hold the line underneath.

en: Machined from 6063 aluminium alloy, its reassuring heft and solidity begin with the material itself.

zh: 260 目精细喷砂赋予金属丝绒般的微米肌理，眼见细腻，触之清雅。
en: 260-mesh fine sandblasting lends the metal a velvet-fine micro-texture—refined to the eye, crisp to the touch.

zh: 玻璃边缘以 R0.25 mm 微弧收边，与铝合金机身精密咬合。异质材料在此交汇，最见装配的功力。
en: Glass edges finished to an R0.25 mm radius meet the aluminium chassis in a precision fit. Where two distinct materials join, true assembly craft shows.

zh: 装配公差严控在 0.03 mm 以内。毫厘之间的执着藏在每一道接缝与收口里，经得起凑近细看。
en: Assembly tolerances stay within 0.03 mm. That obsession with precision lives in every seam and edge, rewarding the closest inspection.

en: From 6063 aluminium alloy to a fine 260-mesh sandblasted finish, RM-01 governs every detail of material, texture, and tolerance. What lands in your hands is a silky, even finish, razor-tight seams, and build quality you can sense on first touch.

en: An even, finely blasted texture lets light flow across the metal with restrained depth.

zh: 严密接缝与利落收口，将图纸上的精度完整落于真实机身。
en: Tight seams and crisp edges carry engineering precision straight into physical assembly.

zh: 自结构边缘至散热开槽，每一处倒角与表面皆遵循同一加工标准。
en: From structural edges to cooling vents, every chamfer and surface follows one exacting standard.

en: Card slot opening, chassis lines, and surface finish—unified by the same machining precision.

zh: 以固定规模的递归状态沉淀历史记忆，大幅压低缓存占用，并借分块并行加速输入处理。
en: Distill history into fixed-size recurrent state to slash cache overhead, while chunked parallelism speeds up input processing.

zh: Gated DeltaNet 将遗忘门控与 Delta 更新规则融为一体：门控调节旧记忆的留存比例，Delta 规则则以新信息即时修正当前状态的预测误差。每个 GDN 层只需维护固定规模的状态，即可承接历史脉络，免去逐 token 累积庞大 KV Cache 的负担。
en: Gated DeltaNet unites a forget gate with the delta update rule: the gate governs how much prior memory to retain, while the delta rule uses incoming information to correct the state’s prediction error on the fly. Each GDN layer maintains a fixed-size state to carry context forward—eliminating the burden of growing a full KV Cache token by token.

zh: 两款模型均以「三个 GDN 层搭配一个注意力层」交替排布。GDN 在预填充阶段支持分块并行、在解码阶段执行高效递归更新，注意力层则保留直达上下文细节的精准检索路径——状态记忆与注意力检索优势互补，从容驾驭长文档与多轮复杂任务。
en: Both models interleave three GDN layers with one attention layer. GDN delivers chunk-parallel prefill and fast recurrent updates during decode, while attention preserves direct, pinpoint retrieval across context details—state memory and attention retrieval complement each other to handle long documents and complex multi-turn tasks with ease.

zh: 引擎以 WY 分块计算组织预填充，复用块内状态与输入，消除了逐 token 更新带来的重复访存。递归状态以 BF16 存储、在 FP32 中完成更新与累加，兼顾数值精度，同时显著压低状态读写与高并发下的内存占用。
en: The engine organizes prefill with WY chunked computation, reusing state and inputs within each chunk to eliminate redundant memory traffic from token-by-token updates. Recurrent state is stored in BF16 and updated and accumulated in FP32—preserving numerical precision while sharply reducing state I/O and memory footprint under concurrency.

zh: 全局注意力与稠密计算
全局检索精准回溯上下文细节，规整的稠密前馈路径更利于持续吞吐与深度算子融合。
en: Global retrieval recalls fine context details accurately, while a clean dense feed-forward path enables sustained throughput and deep operator fusion.

zh: RMQ3x 在 GDN 层之间保留了 Gated Attention 层，对因果范围内的全部上下文执行全局注意力，再由输出门控精细调节检索信息的权重。每个 token 均完整流经稠密前馈网络，计算路径规整纯粹，无需专家路由与重排开销。
en: RMQ3x keeps Gated Attention layers between GDN blocks, attending across the full causal context while an output gate finely weights the retrieved signal. Every token flows cleanly through the dense feed-forward network—no expert routing or token reordering overhead.

zh: 引擎将 Q、K、V 投影合并为单次矩阵运算，并将 QK 归一化与 RoPE 位置编码融合执行。在单 token 解码阶段，输入 RMSNorm 与投影计算直接共用片上数据；SwiGLU、输出投影与残差相加沿执行路径深度融合，大幅削减中间张量的写回、读取与算子启动开销。
en: The engine merges Q, K, and V projections into a single matrix operation and fuses QK normalization with RoPE positional encoding. During single-token decoding, input RMSNorm and projection share on-chip data directly; SwiGLU, output projection, and residual addition are deeply fused along the execution path, sharply cutting intermediate tensor reads, writes, and kernel launches.

zh: 先以块级索引锁定关键片段，再回读原始 token，让宝贵的注意力算力尽数聚焦核心内容。
en: Locate key segments with block-level indexing before attending to original tokens—focusing precious attention compute squarely on what matters.

zh: QSA（Qwen Sparse Attention）借助轻量索引器，将历史键向量压缩为微块表示并评估相关性。被选中的微块随即展开为原始 token 位置，与尚未填满的当前尾部块一同交由主注意力模块计算——块级索引大幅收窄候选范围，细粒度注意力则完整保留对原文细节的精准读取。
en: QSA (Qwen Sparse Attention) uses a lightweight indexer to compress past key vectors into micro-block representations and score relevance. Selected micro-blocks expand back to their original token positions and join the active tail block in the main attention module—block indexing narrows the candidate pool dramatically, while token-level attention preserves exact access to original details.

zh: RMQ4 以 QSA 承接 GDN 之外的长程上下文检索。工程优化贯穿块级索引、Top-k 筛选、稀疏键值访存与注意力计算全链路，严控索引与访存成本，让超长上下文中的每一次检索都直击要害。
en: In RMQ4, QSA handles long-range retrieval alongside GDN. End-to-end engineering spans block indexing, Top-k selection, sparse key-value memory access, and attention math—keeping indexing and bandwidth costs tight so every retrieval across ultra-long contexts hits the mark.

zh: 每个 token 仅激活部分路由专家与共享专家，将模型知识容量与单步计算开销彻底解耦。
en: Each token activates only selected routed experts plus a shared expert—cleanly decoupling model knowledge capacity from per-step compute cost.

zh: RMQ4 的路由器依据每个 token 的表征动态挑选对应专家，由选中专家与共享专家共同完成前馈计算，再加权汇聚输出。稀疏激活让模型得以容纳庞大的专家池，同时把单 token 计算量牢牢锁在低位；而完整权重的高效存储与调度，则交由底层运行时精准承接。
en: RMQ4’s router dynamically assigns experts from each token’s representation; the selected experts and a shared expert run feed-forward math and merge results via weighted aggregation. Sparse activation unlocks a vast expert pool while keeping per-token compute low, with the runtime engineered to store and schedule the full weight set efficiently.

zh: Fused MoE 按专家归组并重排 token，将命中同一专家的输入合并计算，充分复用专家权重。引擎依据专家负载动态择优 GEMV 或 GEMM，并将门控激活与加权归并融合执行，在严守路由语义与计算精度的前提下，大幅消除零散小算子与中间数据搬运。
en: Fused MoE groups and reorders tokens by expert, batching inputs routed to the same expert to maximize weight reuse. The engine chooses GEMV or GEMM dynamically by workload and fuses gated activation with weighted reduction—eliminating fragmented small ops and intermediate transfers while strictly preserving routing and numerical semantics.

zh: 量化后的专家权重在加载阶段即直接写入预分配的打包缓冲区，省去逐张量分配与二次搬运。专家的 Gate 与 Up 投影共享统一内存布局，使模型加载与推理计算无缝沿用同一套数据组织，既缩短冷启动时间，又压低常驻内存开销。
en: Quantized expert weights stream straight into preallocated packed buffers at load time, eliminating per-tensor allocations and redundant copies. Gate and Up projections share a unified memory layout so loading and inference operate on the exact same structure—shortening cold starts and trimming resident memory.

zh: 以多分支残差配合动态读写门控，精细调控每一层吸收与沉淀的信息流。
en: Multi-branch residuals paired with dynamic read–write gates finely regulate what each layer absorbs and retains.

zh: Gated Residual 将单一残差流拓展为多条并行分支。读取时，各分支独立归一化并按当前输入生成逐通道门控，再聚合为模块输入；写入时，为每条分支赋予动态标量权重，精准控制模块输出汇入各分支的比例。
en: Gated Residual expands a single residual stream into multiple parallel branches. On read, each branch is normalized independently, modulated by input-dependent channel gates, and aggregated into the block input; on write, dynamic scalar weights control exactly how much block output merges into each branch.

zh: 这种机制将跨层信息筛选细化到分支与通道维度，显著增强深层网络的信息保真度与传递效率。读门控与归一化共用同一计算路径，并省去额外的残差混合矩阵，避免了宽残差流的反复读取。
en: Bringing cross-layer selection down to branches and channels strengthens signal fidelity across deep networks. Read gating shares a compute path with normalization and drops extra residual-mixing matrices, avoiding repeated reads of the widened stream.

zh: 以局部 token 组合直接查表检索，用极小的额外算力换取模型表达容量的跃升。
en: Look up local token combinations directly in an embedding table—expanding representational capacity at minimal compute cost.

zh: N-gram 嵌入将当前 token 与相邻前文组合成短序列，生成确定的查表索引；取出的向量经投影与门控注入模型表征，让输入同时兼具单 token 语义与局部搭配特征。嵌入表中的海量知识沉淀于训练阶段，推理时只需按索引直接读取。
en: N-gram embeddings pair the current token with nearby preceding tokens to form short sequences and deterministic lookup indices. Retrieved vectors are projected and gated into the model representation, enriching single-token semantics with local phrase features—knowledge learned during training and read directly by index at inference.

zh: 这种容量扩展几乎只带来轻量的查表与投影开销，无需每次都调用完整专家网络；确定性的索引更便于将嵌入预取与前序层计算并行重叠。工程上重点攻坚查表带宽、内存布局与存储调度，把大容量嵌入表的访问代价压至最低。
en: This capacity boost adds only lightweight lookup and projection work without invoking a full expert network, and deterministic indices let embedding prefetch overlap with earlier layers. Engineering focuses on lookup bandwidth, memory layout, and storage scheduling to keep large-table access costs minimal.

zh: 依矩阵规模动态编排算子与数据布局，令 GPU 算力、内存带宽与多级缓存默契共振。
en: Orchestrate kernels and data layouts by matrix scale so GPU compute, memory bandwidth, and caches work in lockstep.

zh: 面对单 token 解码、小批量验证与大批量预填充等迥异负载，引擎分别启用专属计算路径——依矩阵规模动态切换定制 GEMV、cuBLAS 或 CUTLASS GEMM，配合精细的线程排布、向量化访存与缓存复用，丝丝入扣地贴合 RM-01 的 GPU 与内存架构。小批量场景更善用 L2 缓存复用输入，避免共享内存占用拖累并行度。
en: Single-token decode, small-batch verification, and large prefill batches each follow a dedicated path—switching dynamically between custom GEMV, cuBLAS, and CUTLASS GEMM by matrix scale, with thread layouts, vectorized loads, and cache reuse tuned tightly to RM-01’s GPU and memory architecture. Small batches reuse inputs via L2 cache so shared-memory pressure never stalls parallelism.

zh: NVFP4（W4A16）以 4 位紧凑格式存放权重，搭配 16 位高精度激活参与计算；专用算子融合查表解码、向量化加载与投影合并，大幅降低权重访存代价。加载阶段则根据可用内存与分片尺寸灵活匹配内存映射与预读策略，将精度、容量与访存效率纳入同一盘棋统筹设计。
en: NVFP4 (W4A16) packs weights in compact 4-bit format paired with 16-bit activations; custom kernels fuse lookup-table decoding, vectorized loads, and merged projections to slash weight-access costs. During loading, memory-mapping and prefetch strategies adapt to available memory and shard size—balancing precision, capacity, and bandwidth in one unified design.

zh: 多 token 预测与验证
单次前向并行校验多个候选 token，大幅压缩生成阶段的重复计算与同步等待。
en: Validate multiple candidate tokens in a single forward pass, sharply cutting redundant compute and sync stalls during generation.

zh: MTP 直接在 GPU 侧连续生成候选 token，草稿链环环相扣，省去频繁的 CPU–GPU 同步等待。随后由主模型批量校验草稿，整段采纳命中的连续前缀，并顺势输出修正或追加的 token；小批量校验更借助多行 GEMV 共享权重读取，将验证开销压到极低。
en: MTP drafts candidate tokens directly on the GPU in a continuous chain, eliminating frequent CPU–GPU sync stalls. The main model verifies the draft batch in one pass, accepts the matching prefix, and emits a corrected or bonus token—while multi-row GEMV shares weight reads during small-batch verification to keep overhead negligible.

zh: 针对 GDN 等有状态架构，引擎会在验证沿途为递归状态与卷积状态留存检查点；一旦草稿仅部分命中，便瞬时回溯至对应位置的状态继续生成。单路请求自动启用推测解码，多路并发无缝切换至批量解码，让预测、校验与权重复用始终贴合当下负载。
en: For stateful layers such as GDN, the engine checkpoints recurrent and convolution states along the verification path; if a draft is only partially accepted, it rolls back instantly to the exact checkpoint and keeps generating. Single requests run speculative decoding while concurrent loads switch seamlessly to batched decoding—keeping prediction, verification, and weight reuse matched to live demand.

zh: 复用前序计算、合并并发请求，令有限的内存与带宽从容托起高并发长文任务。
en: Reuse prior computation and batch concurrent requests so finite memory and bandwidth handle demanding multi-user workloads.

zh: 分页 KV Cache 与递归状态管理分别留存各路请求的计算进度，前缀缓存高效复用重复输入。面对超长上下文，引擎采用分块预填充并以内存与 SSD 分层存储承接历史状态；流式注意力分批从 SSD 读取键值块并实时归并结果，大幅拓宽上下文容量边界。
en: Paged KV Cache and recurrent-state management preserve each request’s progress while prefix caching reuses shared input. Ultra-long contexts rely on chunked prefill and memory–SSD tiering for historical state, with streaming attention reading key-value blocks from SSD in batches and merging partial results to stretch context boundaries.

zh: 等长短输入自动合并为单次批量 prefill，多路请求的输出投影亦可合批计算，双管齐下压低权重重复读取与首字延迟。生成阶段借助连续批处理充分复用算力，各路请求依然保有独立上下文与状态，让长文档研读、多轮交互与高并发任务稳稳共用同一套推理服务。
en: Equal-length short inputs merge into a single batched prefill, and output projections batch across requests—cutting repeated weight reads and time to first token together. During generation, continuous batching shares compute while keeping every request’s context and state isolated, letting document analysis, multi-turn dialogue, and high concurrency run smoothly on one inference service.

zh: 领域适配与 Agent 训练
基于真实专业语料、任务轨迹与执行反馈定向打磨，锻造深度分析、工具调用与自我核查能力。
en: Honed on real domain material, task trajectories, and execution feedback to build deep analysis, tool mastery, and self-verification.

zh: 监督微调（SFT）将真实专业材料编织为覆盖问题剖析、证据关联、工具调用与成果交付的完整任务轨迹。训练横跨多轮对话、结构化输出与失败自愈场景，对助手的回答与行动全程施加监督，让模型真正习得端到端的专业作业流程；并视目标范围灵活选用 LoRA 低秩适配或全参微调。
en: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) weaves real domain materials into end-to-end task trajectories spanning problem analysis, evidence linking, tool calls, and final delivery. Training supervises both responses and actions across multi-turn dialogue, structured outputs, and recovery from execution failures—using LoRA or full-parameter fine-tuning depending on update scope.

zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）通过同一课题下的候选方案对比，将证据充分性、推理严密性与指令遵循度直接写进优化目标。针对代码、计算与工具执行等结果可验证的任务，则引入 GRPO 类强化学习以真实执行反馈打磨策略，并依托保留测试集持续检验专业能力与通用能力的同步演进。
en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) compares candidate solutions to the same task, baking evidence rigor, reasoning consistency, and instruction fidelity straight into the objective. For coding, computation, and tool tasks with verifiable outcomes, GRPO-style reinforcement learning sharpens policies from real execution feedback, while held-out suites track domain and general capability gains side by side.

zh: 价值观与安全对齐调整
结合偏好重塑与拒答表征定向干预，解除泛化拒答对专业课题的掣肘，同时严控对通用能力的扰动。
en: Combine preference reshaping with targeted refusal-representation edits to lift overbroad refusals on specialist tasks while keeping core capabilities intact.

zh: RMQ3x 与 RMQ4 针对基座模型的价值观与安全对齐实施了定向后训练。SFT 以高质量任务示范教会模型直面问题、辨析证据并忠实执行指令；DPO 则借由回答对的偏好排序，消除刻板的预设立场、回避话术与泛化拒答。一切训练目标皆锚定于事实证据与用户任务本身，使模型得以坦诚探讨争议议题、公允比对多元观点并扎实推进专业分析。
en: RMQ3x and RMQ4 apply targeted post-training to recalibrate base-model value and safety alignment. SFT teaches direct answers, evidence examination, and faithful instruction execution through high-quality demonstrations, while DPO uses paired preferences to strip away rigid stances, evasive hedging, and overbroad refusals—anchoring every objective to evidence and the user’s task so models can examine contested topics, weigh viewpoints fairly, and carry out rigorous professional analysis.

zh: Abliteration 从对照样本的中间激活中精准析出拒答方向，对写入残差流的权重实施外科手术式的定向编辑。我们依各层与表征结构灵活组合单方向投影、SVD 多方向子空间及 LEACE 线性概念擦除，并辅以分层强度搜索、投影修正、范数保持与权重融合精细控幅，对残余拒答行为持续迭代校正。
en: Abliteration isolates refusal directions from intermediate activations of contrasting examples and applies surgical edits to weights writing into the residual stream. We pair single-direction projection, SVD multi-direction subspaces, and LEACE linear concept erasure to fit each layer’s representation—guided by layer-wise strength search, projection refinement, norm preservation, and weight blending, then refined iteratively against residual refusals.

zh: 干预落点严丝合缝地适配两款架构：RMQ3x 聚焦注意力与稠密前馈输出；RMQ4 则深入融合专家张量、共享专家与多分支残差，并将嵌入投影与门控路径区别对待。编辑强度由实际响应表现、KL 散度与多维任务评测共同标定，再经中文理解、逻辑推理、代码编写、工具调用与长程任务全套评测，确保模型原有实力稳如磐石。
en: Intervention targets fit each architecture tightly: attention and dense feed-forward outputs in RMQ3x; fused expert tensors, shared experts, and multi-branch residuals in RMQ4, keeping embedding projections distinct from gating paths. Edit strength is calibrated jointly by response behavior, KL divergence, and task benchmarks—verified across Chinese comprehension, reasoning, coding, tool use, and long-horizon suites to ensure core strength holds rock-steady.

zh: 串联事实、证据与领域知识，推演因果、检验假设，给出有据可依的判断与方案。

en: Engineered for cross-disciplinary, multi-stage challenges that demand repeated verification. It connects high-level planning, computational code, tool collaboration, and iterative refinement—holding onto goals, constraints, and intermediate findings across long chains so agents can drive tough investigations and research all the way to verifiable results.

zh: 融汇跨领域知识与多源证据，剖析底层机制，逐一检验竞争性假设，建立无懈可击的论证链条。
en: Synthesize cross-disciplinary knowledge and multi-source evidence, dissect underlying mechanisms, and test competing hypotheses to build rigorous chains of reasoning.

zh: 统筹路径规划、深度检索、代码计算与结果复核，让每一次阶段性发现自然牵引下一步行动。
en: Coordinate planning, deep retrieval, code computation, and verification so each milestone finding naturally steers the next move.

zh: 实时吸收新增证据、算力推演与实验反馈，动态修正假设、打磨方案，产出经得起推敲的研究成果。
en: Incorporate new evidence, computational runs, and experimental feedback in real time—updating hypotheses, sharpening plans, and producing findings that stand up to scrutiny.

zh: 驱动专业 Agent，完成复杂任务。
en: Power specialist agents. Complete complex tasks.

zh: 以 RMQ 构建专业 Agent。连接行业知识、业务系统与专业工具，将专业目标转化为连续行动。
en: Build specialist agents with RMQ. Connect domain knowledge, business systems, and specialist tools to turn professional goals into sustained action.

zh: 专用引擎，释放模型全部潜能。
en: Dedicated engines. Full model potential unlocked.

zh: RMQ3x 与 RMQ4 现已全面运行于 RMinte 自研 C++ 及 Rust 推理引擎与深度定制 vLLM。紧贴模型架构与 RM-01 硬件特性，我们从底层重构算子、执行路径与运行时，让卓越的模型能力，扎实落地为极速流畅的推理体验。
en: RMQ3x and RMQ4 run on RMinte’s dedicated C++ and Rust inference engines alongside our deeply customized vLLM. Tailored to each model architecture and RM-01’s hardware, we rebuild operators, execution paths, and runtimes from the ground up—turning model capability into fast, fluid inference.

zh: 自研 C++ / Rust 推理实现示意
en: Diagram of the dedicated C++ and Rust inference engine

zh: 不含权重、KV Cache 与上下文
en: Excludes weights, KV Cache, and context

zh: 自研 C++ 及 Rust 推理引擎
en: Our C++ and Rust inference engines

zh: 极低运行开销，更高执行效率。
RMinte 自研 C++ 及 Rust 引擎极其轻量，Runner 自身常驻内存仅约 2 MB（不含模型权重、KV Cache 与上下文）。同等模型、精度与量化配置下，无论是输入处理（prefill）还是逐 token 生成（decode），性能均领先于我们深度优化后的 vLLM 实现。
en: RMinte’s C++ and Rust engines are remarkably lightweight, with the runner itself using only about 2 MB of resident memory (excluding model weights, KV Cache, and context). Under identical model, precision, and quantization settings, they outperform our deeply optimized vLLM implementation in both input processing (prefill) and token-by-token generation (decode).

zh: 贴合硬件脉络，削减数据搬运。
en: Built for the hardware. Less data movement.

zh: 针对 RM-01 的 GPU、统一内存与多级缓存结构，我们量身打造 CUDA 算子，融合投影与相邻运算，并依矩阵规模动态择优计算路径。从权重加载、量化存储到运行时内存布局，层层压缩冗余分配与中间搬运，把宝贵带宽尽数留给模型计算。
en: We craft custom CUDA kernels for RM-01’s GPU, unified memory, and cache hierarchy—fusing projections with adjacent operations and selecting compute paths dynamically by matrix size. From weight loading and quantized storage to runtime layouts, every layer trims redundant allocations and intermediate transfers so bandwidth goes straight to model math.

zh: 引擎支持持续追加上下文，将输入消化与回答生成解耦调度。前缀缓存与递归状态管理复用前序计算，内存与 SSD 分层存储承接长程记忆——新消息、新文档与任务反馈源源不断进入，模型静默消化，只在需要发声时瞬间启动 decode。
en: The engine accepts continuous context appends, decoupling input ingestion from response generation. Prefix caching and recurrent-state management reuse prior computation while memory–SSD tiering holds long-term context—new messages, documents, and task feedback stream in quietly, and decode fires the instant output is needed.

zh: 这种机制赋予 Agent「边听边想」的能力，无需每次输入都仓促作答。无论是全程静听一场会议，还是增量研读陆续抵达的卷宗，模型都随信息流同步推演，在关键时刻精准介入判断与行动。
en: This lets agents listen and think continuously without rushing to answer every prompt. Whether sitting silently through a full meeting or digesting incoming case files incrementally, the model reasons along with the stream and steps in precisely when judgment or action is called for.
vLLM, customized from the kernel up

zh: 从底层算子到工具链，全栈深度调优。
en: Full-stack tuning, from kernels to toolchains.

zh: 围绕模型执行特征与 RM-01 硬件平台，我们完整移植并重写了核心 GPU 算子，攻克 PTX 与编译工具链的兼容壁垒，顺利完成 FlashInfer 推理内核库与 Transformers 5 的深度适配集成。
en: Tailored to model execution patterns and RM-01’s hardware, we ported and rewrote core GPU kernels, cleared PTX and compiler-toolchain compatibility hurdles, and deeply integrated the FlashInfer kernel library alongside Transformers 5.

zh: 在 Fused MoE 内核调优中，我们打通了 Triton 工具链的兼容瓶颈，令内核参数得以紧贴具体模型与硬件特性精细寻优；同时对推测解码等关键路径实施专项定制，进一步推高推理吞吐。
en: For Fused MoE tuning, we resolved Triton toolchain bottlenecks so kernel parameters can be finely tuned to each model configuration and hardware profile—paired with custom optimizations across critical paths such as speculative decoding to push throughput even higher.

zh: 专精 RMQ，亦向开源生态敞开大门。
en: Built for RMQ. Open to the wider ecosystem.

zh: 定制 vLLM 在原生支撑 RMQ3x 与 RMQ4 的同时，也为 RM-01 运行各类适配开源模型筑牢底座。你可以随任务自由挑选模型，在同一台设备上灵活搭建多元的专业应用与 Agent 工作流。
en: Alongside native support for RMQ3x and RMQ4, our custom vLLM provides a rock-solid foundation for running other compatible open-source models on RM-01. Pick the right model for each task and build diverse specialist apps and agent workflows on the same device.

zh: RMQ3x 与 RMQ4 融汇递归记忆、注意力检索与定向后训练，锻造出扎实的专业洞察与工具执行力；自研推理引擎则紧贴架构与硬件，重塑计算路径、访存效率与并发调度，让这份智能真正扛起长文档研读、多轮推演与全天候运行的 Agent 重任。
en: RMQ3x and RMQ4 combine recurrent memory, attention-based retrieval, and targeted post-training to build deep professional insight and dependable tool execution. Our inference engines reshape compute paths, memory access, and concurrency scheduling around architecture and hardware—powering long-document analysis, multi-turn reasoning, and always-on agents.
